name: The sandbox, schematic
title: The sandbox, schematic
story: The pod and its wall appear, the agent at work inside. Probes toward the internet, the host, the cloud metadata address and a push token stop at a cross. One model call goes through the gateway, held against the card's budget, then booked. More calls fill the budget to the cap and the factory asks: fund it or end it. The agent ends, a fresh token pushes once and is revoked, the pod is deleted.
